behavior.todo: the behavior model, after asyncCells: {model: S* of MODEL.bend, laws: S* of LAWS.bend, prefix, bound, observation, outOfScope, notFormalized, conformance: a contract key, lawRows: [{name, kind, cites [P*]}]}; an effect law needs a witness law for its policy

notApplicable.todo: a sourced N/A for each auto test case no contract row covers (중복, 오류, 재시도, 빈-데이터, 로딩, out-of-order, 취소): {text naming it, sources [approved S*]}; [] when the rows cover all seven

typeContract.todo: no exported Props, shared API, state union or trust-boundary type: {notApplicable: <why>, paths: [repo:<investigated file>]}; otherwise remove it (set <path> null) and run the type-contract:reported label
